title: polygala refracta var. steudeliana
intro: Polygala refracta var. steudeliana, commonly known as Purple Milkwort, is a perennial plant species that belongs to the Polygalaceae family. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including respiratory issues and urinary tract problems. The Purple Milkwort is reported to possess therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its potential health benefits. The bioactive constituents of the plant, including flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, are responsible for its medicinal properties and may provide protection against oxidative stress and inflammation.
